A deterministic suffix output transition system is a deterministic output transition system that can produce suffix outputs.

  • Method Details

    • computeStateOutput

      D computeStateOutput(S state, Iterable<? extends I> input)
      Computes the output for the given sequence of input symbols beginning from the given state.
      Parameters:
      state - the start from which the output computation should start
      input - the sequence of input symbols
      Returns:
      the computed output
      Throws:
      UndefinedPropertyAccessException - if the computation encountered undefined transitions that would have been required for computing the output
